A man named Alan went to see his mother,
Who was quite keen to talk with him.
He said, "Mother, did I do well today?"
She replied, "Indeed you did,
And your dad will be proud of what he's seen."
His father came in and said with a grin,
"I've just watched the birds on the swing,
And they're singing a lovely song
That echoes like a bell."
The mother smiled at her son's wit,
"And it makes me so happy to have you at my side.
You know, Alan, I'll always be here for you,
No matter what life throws your way.
So cherish every moment, and never give up,
For with love and determination, anything is possible."

In a world that's sometimes quite confusing,
It's good to know that some things will forever be true.
Like the words in this palindrome,
Which will always be read the same way forward or backward.
